purpose: Mechanical authorization-boundary inventory of every hosted API route family (rc11 internal security review F-04, owner addendum §E GATE 2). Verified by sdk/test/authorization-boundary-inventory.test.js: every route family literal in server/src/scopes.js and server/src/api.js must appear here; machine scopes must match requiredScopesFor; every non-public route must name an auth gate that its own handler block or family prelude calls, comments stripped (RC45 R1-02); every tenant-owned route must name a tenancy resolver and (for mutations) a mutation gate bound the same way (a parameterized gate only where it is called with { mutation: true }), plus a hostile-evidence test that contains a request path matching its full route pattern, exact version segment included, with a foreign principal; `void principal`-style discards are lint failures unless listed under documentedExceptions.

routes.note: RC45 R1-01 (S-01, C6; row corrected to the code by R1-02): in this order, a missing signedSafeJson is the closed 400 BAD_SIGNATURE; then authentication (hosted: 401 for an unauthenticated caller); then a missing or non-v0.2 record answers 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND before the signer gate, so no non-v0.2 record (a v0.4 or v0.7-kas genesis or transition among them) reaches the v0.2 signing and broadcast pipeline; then the signer gate. sdk/src/wallet-requests-v2.js attachWalletSignatureV2 also refuses a non-v0.2 record (defence in depth). rc13 review N-02: a participant that is not the request's signer (an agent on the owner's request, the owner on its agent's) gets 403 NOT_THE_SIGNER before any state can change; malformed payloads are a closed 400 BAD_SIGNATURE

routes.mutationGate: collectApprovalV4: the approver signature is verified against the approval package (a 65-byte SIG_HASH_ALL signature over the frozen covenant input, in the approver's fixed slot); for an invalid one nothing is written to the approvals or the request state (the build-derived, empty approval package may be materialized first)
routes.note: RC45 R1-02 (S-02): row corrected to the code. The route calls requireRequestAccess (read access: a covenant participant of the vault or the request's signer; a foreign principal gets the non-oracle 404), not requireRequestMutation, because approver-only principals must reach it. The approver's authority is its approval signature alone: approverAddress names the slot and only a valid signature by that configured approver over the frozen covenant input is accepted. The route's code is unchanged

routes.note: RC45 F3 A2 (H-11): hosted rejection is narrowed to the request's signer or the vault owner (template.owner); any other participant (an agent on the owner's request or on another agent's) gets 403 REQUEST_FORBIDDEN with nothing changed; a foreign principal keeps the non-oracle 404 and an approver-only principal the 403 of requestMutationAllowed; owner-minted machine credentials act as the owner (CR-I4). Hostile evidence: the v0.4 reject legs of the named suite (RC45 R1-01: a FOREIGN principal 404, an UNAUTHENTICATED caller 401, an agent on the owner's requests and an approver-only principal 403 REQUEST_FORBIDDEN, the signer or the owner 200, nothing written on any refusal), the A2 legs of sdk/test/rc45-t8-api-routes.test.js (another agent 403 REQUEST_FORBIDDEN, a foreign principal 404; its request paths are spelled in sdk/testutil/rc45-f3-kit.js) and sdk/test/rc45-t3-owner-breakglass.test.js (an agent on the owner's request 403)
